messages:
anya: kicking off a controlled rollout for redwood/v3.1-int4 — starting at 1% reservoir, target 10% over 4h. primary signals: P95 latency, concordance, rerank score drift.
vikram: ack. add gating: min_sample=500 per slice and concordance >= 0.92 to allow each step to advance.
sam: quick clarifying q — how does the "reservoir" behave for long sessions? is it token-based or session-based?
anya: reservoir = session-lease pool. each new session draws a lease token; token TTL and refill control how many unique sessions hit the new model. intended to limit surface for long-lived users.
infra-bot: deploy job started: canary group canary-03; image sha: b7f3a2e; canary config pushed to cluster.
anya: rollout config (pushed):
```
rollout:
  model: redwood/v3.1-int4
  initial_percent: 1
  max_percent: 10
  ramp_hours: 4
  reservoir: true
  min_sample: 500
  longdoc_min_sample: 800
  concordance_threshold: 0.92
  p95_latency_increase_halt_pct: 30
  hysteresis_windows: 3
  lease_ttl_min: 30
  escape_target: redwood/v3.0
```
lina: please add an automatic escape hatch: if P95 latency increases by >30% OR concordance drops by >4 percentage points for 3 consecutive windows -> immediate failover to redwood/v3.0. include a 2-window hysteresis on re-entry. :warning:
vikram: also propose throttle behaviour when escape triggers: per-user throttle to 5 req/min and reduce reservoir by 75% immediately. makes failure impact predictable.
sam: for longdoc slice we should require more power: longdoc_min_sample=800 and concordance >= 0.94, otherwise block ramp for that slice. longdoc drift tends to hide in small samples.
anya: noted — I'll update the rollout config to include longdoc override.
ops: watchlist created: pagerduty rule "canary-v3.1-int4" created, alerts for p95>threshold and concordance drop. dashboards linked.
infra-bot: smoke tests: kv-cache warmup 85% at t+2m (warning), offline-rerank sanity passed. not blocking.
lina: reminder: run the offline "user-feedback-A" prompt set audit before passing 5% — that bucket caught recall regressions last time. :eyes:
anya: plan: mid-roll audit at 2h mark. auto-decrease algorithm: if any gate metric exceeds allowed delta, reduce allocation by 50% (e.g., 4% -> 2%) and re-evaluate after 30m.
vikram: +1. also implement exponential backoff for lease refill: refill_multiplier=0.5 on each failed window to avoid oscillation.
sam: ok to proceed from my side. launching now. :rocket:
